observation.initial_state: A large cluster of shiny black spheres is held together by two hands on a white surface.
visible_changes: Early: The hands grip the cluster, and the right hand begins to pull a smaller group of spheres away from the main mass.
Middle: The right hand successfully separates a small ring-like cluster of spheres, holding it up while the left hand releases the remaining larger cluster onto the surface.
Late: The right hand moves the separated small cluster towards the center, places it down next to the larger cluster, and then both hands move out of frame.
observation.final_state: Two distinct groups of black spheres rest on the white surface: a larger irregular cluster on the left and a smaller ring-shaped cluster on the right. The hands are no longer visible.
